summary: Careers Phase 3 Extended tested end-to-end. Backend: 4/4 pytest scenarios pass (full apply with all docs + education/work_history, no-docs + malformed JSON, duplicate email, invalid document kind). Frontend public /careers apply flow submits successfully with resume+Aadhaar+PAN uploads and dynamic education/work rows (add + remove work correctly, remove disabled when only 1 row). Admin /admin/careers Applications tab opens modal for the freshly created application: education (B.Tech CSE / IIT Bombay / 2024 / 9.2 CGPA) and work history (SWE @ Acme Corp / 01/2024→Present) render, Download Aadhaar & Download PAN buttons render and clicking triggers window.open to /api/public/careers/applications/{app_id}/document/{kind} URLs. Marksheet button correctly hidden when not uploaded.

issues: Marksheet download button is hidden when the doc was not uploaded — acceptable but could be shown disabled with 'Not uploaded' hint for clearer admin UX (currently only Aadhaar+PAN buttons appear if only those two are uploaded).

critical_code_review_comments: careers_investors.py list_applications returns raw file-system paths in aadhaar_path/pan_path/marksheet_path fields — leaks server FS structure to any public caller of GET /api/public/careers/applications (this endpoint is not auth-gated). Consider returning booleans (or presence flags) and gate the listing behind admin auth.
POST /api/public/careers/apply is fully public with no rate limiting; anyone can spam applications and 5MB uploads across four file fields (=20MB per request) — recommend basic rate limit + captcha.

aadhaar/pan/marksheet content-type is inferred from extension only; server does not validate that the uploaded file is actually a PDF/image (could accept renamed .exe). Consider MIME sniffing / python-magic check.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 TEST_ prefixed applications (TEST_fe_*, TEST_p3_full_*, TEST_p3_min_*, TEST_p3_dup_*) under active job JOB-20260419-E4E896 (Full Stack Developer). Application APP-20260809082402-9B661A used for admin modal verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 apply-form + admin document download flow fully green. If tightening security around list_applications (see critical review), rerun test_careers_phase3_extended.py — assertions on aadhaar_path/pan_path currently accept truthy strings; adjust if you switch to booleans.
